reconciliation.method: ledger realized gross (avg-cost on execcost) - execcomm (trades+funding+settlement), bucketed to the 12:00 UTC daily posting [D-1 12:00, D 12:00) per symbol, vs wallet RealisedPNL (address=symbol)

leverage.definition: gross perpetual exposure at funding price (sum |funding execcost|) / (wallet balance before snapshot + realized since last 12:00 posting + unrealized at funding price)
